description.value: Donair Dude is a Mediterranean-inspired fast-casual restaurant chain born during Vancouver's 2010 Winter Olympics, now operating multiple BC locations. The menu centres on slow-roasted donair meats sourced from BC farms, served as wraps, platters, poutine, and plates with options spanning chicken, beef, lamb, falafel, and kofte. Its extended evening hours and hearty, freshly prepared food make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists passing through Vancouver's Terminal Avenue corridor.
